expansion.grouping: preserve original 16 V requests; four consecutive expansion questions per new request

grouping: four consecutive question IDs in the frozen V order; every ID appears once
prompt: Read the documents and answer all four questions in order. For each question, explain the relevant facts from its two documents and the connection that gives the answer. Use a short paragraph of 3 to 5 substantive sentences per question. Do not repeat the same facts across questions. After all four explanations, write four separate short-answer lines, using exactly these labels: Final answer 1:, Final answer 2:, Final answer 3:, Final answer 4:. Each line should contain only the answer to the corresponding question, without explanatory sentences.
prompt_position: after documents and the four numbered questions
packing: all four document A blocks, own distractors, gap fillers, all four document B blocks, tail fillers
filler_exclusions: V, expand, T and reconstructed independent pilot question IDs

scoring.extraction: last numbered answer label, including markdown headings; first nonempty line after the label, inline or following, as in the validated pilot; trim surrounding whitespace and markdown emphasis; absent or empty answer scores zero; never consume another numbered answer label
scoring.question_score: existing normalized answer EM and token-F1, on 0-100 scale
scoring.request_f1: arithmetic mean of four question F1 scores, including missing answers as zero
scoring.main_f1: arithmetic mean of request F1 scores
scoring.request_exact: all four normalized answers are exact
scoring.answer_em: mean of four question EM scores within request, then mean across requests
scoring.length_admission: report all 16 requests; separately report BF16 requests with >=256 generated tokens; baseline usable only if this subset is nonempty and its request-mean F1 >=40; same subset used for future paired comparisons
